schema_description: Hugging Face Hub model repository file: the chat template (always opens <think> after <|assistant|>; reads reasoning_effort: low / high, else max).
notes: A reasoning model whose model_type (glm_moe_dsa) names no vLLM parser; vLLM serves its architecture with the glm45 reasoning parser. The planner reads this template to name the parser and the request's reasoning_effort.
